title.zh: 生活口语多语言跟读可靠性修复

purpose.en: Prevent Safari and older iPad sessions from remaining stuck in Listening, align Everyday Speaking with the automatic SmartCard interaction, and provide a bounded multilingual pronunciation fallback.
purpose.zh: 防止 Safari 与旧 iPad 永久停在“正在听”，让生活口语与智慧卡一样自动完成示范、跟读和评分，并提供有时限的多语言发音兜底。

en: Remove the persistent Score/Listening button; AI playback now opens the microphone and scores automatically when Repeat is on.
Use native browser speech recognition first while recording a short transient clip as a multilingual transcription fallback.
Force every listening attempt to finish after five seconds instead of waiting indefinitely for a missing Safari callback.
Retry an unclear phrase automatically up to three attempts and then advance; show a recovery action only when permission or analysis fails.
Validate language, scenario, slide, MIME type, and audio size server-side; never store audio or transcript.
zh: 删除常驻的“跟读评分/正在听”按钮；打开“跟我读”时，AI 示范结束后自动开麦并评分。
优先使用浏览器原生语音识别，同时短暂录音作为多语言转写兜底。
每次聆听最多五秒，Safari 不返回结束事件时也不会无限等待。
未听准时最多自动重练三次后前进；仅在权限或分析失败时显示恢复按钮。
服务器严格校验语言、场景、幻灯片、音频类型和大小，录音与识别文字均不保存。

en: Japanese and all twelve target languages
Safari, Chrome, Edge, iPhone, and iPad microphone flow
zh: 日语及全部十二种目标语言
Safari、Chrome、Edge、iPhone 与 iPad 麦克风流程

en: Add the same getUserMedia, MediaRecorder, native recognition, and watchdog pattern proven by SmartCard practice.
Add a public bounded Everyday Speaking speech endpoint through the unified SmartLingo AI gateway.
Keep the global Repeat preference, slide controls, pause, and quit behavior unchanged.
zh: 采用智慧卡已验证的 getUserMedia、MediaRecorder、原生识别和超时看门狗组合。
通过 SmartLingo 统一 AI 网关增加受限的生活口语发音接口。
全局“跟我读”偏好、幻灯片前后控制、暂停和退出行为保持不变。

en: Production build, TypeScript, sensitive-data scan, changed-file ESLint, and artifact validation pass.
The full repository suite passes 328/328 tests, including twelve languages by twelve scenarios and the new server fallback contract.
The only changed-file lint warning is the existing local scene image performance advisory; there are no lint errors.
zh: 正式构建、TypeScript、敏感数据扫描、本次文件 ESLint 与发布产物验证均通过。
全仓 328/328 项测试通过，包括十二种语言乘十二个场景及新增服务端兜底合同。
本次文件仅保留既有本地场景图片性能提示，无 ESLint 错误。

en: Automated browser control can verify permission, timeout, fallback, and UI state, but it cannot supply a real learner voice; a human pronunciation score will not be fabricated.
zh: 浏览器自动控制可验证权限、超时、兜底和界面状态，但不能提供真人学习者语音；不会伪造发音成绩。

en: This is a SmartLingo-specific language-learning fix and does not alter other portfolio sites.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属语言学习修复，不改变其他站点。
